capabilities: : Store remote note snapshots as encrypted objects
: Provide conflict review and resolution UI
disambiguation: Not a hosted sync service; it is a local-first Obsidian plugin that uses the Git remotes and devices you choose.
intentEvidence: Secure Git Sync is built for users who already use Git to back up or move an Obsidian vault, but want stronger control over private notes and local-first workflows.
motivation: To provide users who already use Git for backup stronger control over private notes and local-first workflows.
problem: Users who rely on Git for vault backup need stronger control over private notes and require secure, local-first workflows.
summary: Secure Git Sync provides password-confirmed Git synchronization for Obsidian vaults, offering optional encrypted remote note snapshots and direct LAN vault syncing.
